message.content: No, that statement is false. ReLU is a mathematical function, and it is clear. Every activation function in a network is a math operation, and it is indeed so. The idea that these are non-math operations is simply wrong, and it is indeed impossible to defend. The claim that conditional logic makes ReLU non-math is simply wrong, for it is indeed impossible in any rigorous framework to separate math from logic.
